nodes.label: localhost/fs
nodes.description: The local filesystem/host the es-merge, es-generate CLIs and the es-view server run on. This is NOT a networked database server: `engine: filesystem` marks that the durable store is plain files on disk reached through node:fs (readFileSync/writeFileSync), addressed by path rather than a connection string. 'localhost/fs' is a synthetic host label; there is no real host/instance to recover because there is no connection string.

nodes.label: examples/event-storming-recovery/model
nodes.description: The model output directory: the on-disk 'database' whose 'tables' are the persisted model store (flows.json) and the two generated view artifacts (explorer.html, flows.dot). The concrete path is an operator-supplied argument (the outFile/outDir the merge and generator are pointed at); this node uses the self-model's own model dir as its label.

tactical.explanation: Written to by the merge CLI (tools/merge-flows.js writeFileSync of the outFile) and the generator (tools/generate-views.js writeFileSync of explorer.html + flows.dot into outDir). The es-view server reads from it via resolve-model.mjs (readModelFile / findFlowsFiles auto-discovery, which prefers `model/flows.json`).

anchors.note: auto-discovery prefers model/flows.json under this dir

nodes.label: flows.json
nodes.description: The persisted canonical model store. A single JSON file assembled and written by the merge, then read back by the es-view server (in-memory) and by the generator. Its 'columns' are the top-level JSON keys: nodes, flows, hotspots, terms, meta (+ version). The authoritative structure is docs/flows-schema.md; the merge code maps the in-memory object onto it.

tactical.explanation: Assembled in mergeTraceDocs as { version, meta, nodes, flows, hotspots, terms } (src/lib/merge.mjs ~215-227) and written to disk by tools/merge-flows.js (writeFileSync of the outFile). Read via resolve-model.mjs readModelFile (JSON.parse + shape check that nodes/flows are arrays).

anchors.note: the assembled model object { version, meta, nodes, flows, hotspots, terms }

nodes.label: explorer.html
nodes.description: A derived view artifact: the self-contained interactive explorer, a single HTML file with the whole model frozen inline as `const MODEL` plus a dependency-free SPA. A materialized VIEW of tbl-flows-json (the generator projects the model into it); it is a frozen static snapshot, not a live read of the store.

tactical.explanation: Built by tools/generate-views.js: the model is JSON.stringify'd (with `<` escaped to \u003c), inlined at `const MODEL = ${modelJson}` (line 438), and the assembled template is written by writeFileSync(outDir/explorer.html) at line 1487.

nodes.label: flows.dot
nodes.description: A derived view artifact: the Graphviz digraph, one cluster per flow with event-storming-colored stickies and labeled edges, for offline rendering (`dot -Tsvg`). A materialized VIEW of tbl-flows-json with the physical-storage nodes (and any edge touching them) deliberately filtered out.

tactical.explanation: Built by the DOT block in tools/generate-views.js (from line 64); datastore/field nodes are excluded via isDataId (37, 73-74). Written by writeFileSync(outDir/flows.dot) at line 91.

anchors.note: per-flow subgraphs; isDataId filters physical nodes

nodes.label: nodes
nodes.description: Top-level JSON key: the deduped array of sticky/physical nodes shared across flows. Assembled by the merge as [...nodes.values()] with transient _src stripped; structure per docs/flows-schema.md (Node).

nodes.label: flows
nodes.description: Top-level JSON key: the array of flow objects (steps, edges, hotspots, instances). Assembled by the merge as [...flows.values()] with transient _sourceFile stripped; structure per docs/flows-schema.md (Flow).

nodes.label: hotspots
nodes.description: Top-level JSON key: the array of hotspot objects referenced from flows. Assembled by the merge as [...hotspots.values()]; structure per docs/flows-schema.md (Hotspot).

nodes.label: terms
nodes.description: Top-level JSON key: the ubiquitous-language term array authored by the glossary-mining phase, sorted case-insensitively by term. Structure per docs/flows-schema.md (Term).

nodes.label: meta
nodes.description: Top-level JSON key: derived/regenerable metadata { generatedFrom, counts, deadFlows, sharedGlossary } computed at merge time (plus title/repoRoot fallbacks). Not hand-authored; recomputed on every merge.

tactical.explanation: Data-return view: the Model's conceptual fields (nodes/flows/hotspots/terms/meta) are assembled by the merge and persisted to tbl-flows-json.

anchors.note: assembled model object persisted to flows.json

fields.name: nodes
fields.derivation: The deduped union of every trace's nodes keyed by global id. First occurrence seeds the node; on a re-seen id the merge keeps the longest description, unions fields[] by name (data-pass authoritative), appends provenance, carries physical attributes (parent/storeKind/fieldKind/dataType/host/nullable), and accumulates a per-flow `usages` entry. Transient `_src` is stripped on output.

sources.note: deduped union by id across all traces

fields.name: flows
fields.derivation: The accumulated flow objects across all traces, keyed by id, FIRST-WINS: a duplicate flow id is a merge ERROR (flows are never merged/unioned like nodes). Written verbatim minus the transient `_sourceFile` key.

sources.note: first-wins accumulation by id; duplicate = error

fields.name: hotspots
fields.derivation: The union of hotspot objects by id across traces, first-wins (a duplicate id is a warning, first kept).

fields.name: terms
fields.derivation: The union of ubiquitous-language terms by id (authored by the glossary-mining phase), first-wins on duplicate, then sorted case-insensitively by `term`.

sources.note: union by id then localeCompare sort

fields.name: meta.counts
fields.derivation: Regenerated tallies computed at merge time: { flows, nodes, hotspots, terms } sizes, unresolvedTerms, and a byType node-type histogram. Not stored input — recomputed from the assembled maps on every merge.

fields.name: meta.sharedGlossary
fields.derivation: The cross-flow shared-concept index: nodes appearing in more than one flow, projected to { id, type, label, description, flowCount, flows } and sorted by flowCount descending. A join of per-flow membership (steps + edge endpoints) against the node set.

fields.name: meta.deadFlows
fields.derivation: The dead/superseded-flow index: flows whose status is not 'live', projected to { id, status, supersededBy, name }.

tactical.explanation: Data-return view: GET /api/model hands back the whole resolved model verbatim; list_model exposes a compact projection.

fields.name: model
fields.derivation: The entire agg-model object (nodes/flows/hotspots/terms/meta) handed back verbatim by GET /api/model. The server resolves it once at startup and holds it in memory; the payload is a straight passthrough of the resolved model, not a re-query. The MCP list_model tool exposes a compact projection of the same object (flows: id/name/status; nodes: id/label/type).

sources.note: resolved from the file (or in-memory merge of --traces) and passed through

evidence.note: compact id index projection of the same model

fields.name: meta
fields.derivation: Resolution provenance wrapped around the model: { source, sourcePath, repoRoot, warnings } describing which strategy resolved the model (--model / --traces / auto-discover / bundled example), the resolved path, the repoRoot, and any resolver warnings. Computed by resolveModel at boot, NOT read from flows.json.
fields.notes: Assembled in src/server/resolve-model.mjs (resolveModel) at process start; held in memory, never persisted.

evidence.note: returns { model, source, sourcePath, repoRoot, warnings }

tactical.explanation: Data-return view: the explorer inlines a frozen copy of the whole model as const MODEL and renders its tabs client-side.

anchors.note: entire model inlined as a frozen snapshot

fields.name: embeddedModel
fields.derivation: A frozen JSON.stringify copy of the entire agg-model inlined into the page as `const MODEL` (with `<` escaped to \u003c so the inline <script> stays safe). The SPA reads ONLY from this constant, never fetching flows.json, so the artifact is a frozen snapshot that drifts once the store changes (see hot-frozen-explorer-snapshot).

sources.note: serialized verbatim copy at generation time

fields.name: flowsBoard
fields.derivation: Flows tab: the sidebar (flows grouped by tier / pivoted by actor or aggregate) plus the pan/zoom board rendering the selected flow's sticky lane and edges. Derived client-side from the embedded model's flows + nodes.

fields.name: gallery
fields.derivation: Gallery tab: nodes grouped by type. Derived from the embedded model's node set.

fields.name: dataModel
fields.derivation: Data model tab: the physical datastore/field containment tree plus the fields[] returned by each read model/aggregate. Derived from the embedded model's physical nodes and their parent chains and from field lineage.

sources.note: physical nodes (datastore/field) + fields[] on rm/agg nodes

fields.name: glossary
fields.derivation: Glossary tab: the ubiquitous-language terms, with flagged (partial/unresolved) terms rendered hotspot-style. Derived from the embedded model's terms.

fields.name: overview
fields.derivation: Overview tab: headline counts and the shared-concept / dead-flow summaries. Derived from the embedded model's meta block.

tactical.explanation: Data-return view: the DOT source projects the model's flows (physical nodes filtered out) into one cluster per flow.

anchors.note: DOT build loop; isDataId drops physical nodes

fields.name: dotDigraph
fields.derivation: The full Graphviz DOT source: one `subgraph cluster_<flowId>` per flow, node ids namespaced `<flowId>__<nodeId>`, stickies colored by type from PALETTE, edges labeled with their verb, and the first tactical anchor attached as a vscode:// URL. Dead/superseded flows render dashed with a [STATUS] suffix. Physical storage nodes (datastore/field) and any edge touching them are filtered out via isDataId, so the DOT view stays purely behavioral.

sources.note: one cluster per flow; edges labeled by verb

tactical.explanation: Data-return view: a per-flow trace file the merge JSON.parses and iterates as raw material; structure defined by docs/flows-schema.md.

fields.name: nodes
fields.derivation: The stickies/physical nodes a deep-trace (or data-mapping) agent authored for one flow. JSON.parsed from a *.json in the traces dir and iterated by the merge as raw material. Structure defined by docs/flows-schema.md (Node).
fields.notes: One *.json per flow on the local filesystem (reached via ext-source-fs); not modeled as its own physical table (see notes).

fields.name: flows
fields.derivation: The flow object(s) a trace agent authored for the flow: steps, edges, hotspots, instances. JSON.parsed and accumulated by the merge (first-wins by id). Structure per docs/flows-schema.md (Flow).

fields.name: hotspots
fields.derivation: The hotspot object(s) authored for the flow (the human-question stickies). Parsed and unioned by the merge. Structure per docs/flows-schema.md (Hotspot).

fields.name: terms
fields.derivation: Optional ubiquitous-language term entries carried in a trace/glossary file. Parsed and unioned by the merge. Structure per docs/flows-schema.md (Term).
